experiment: Skipped. No experiment is active, every metric is within target, and the pause gate (`noNewExperimentsUntil` 2026-11-05) bars a new one. Nothing was evaluated or changed.
weakestArea: Multi-source is the closest to its line at 31% against 30% (32% yesterday, 33% the day before), so it is met but drifting down. Africa fell to 3 stories from 6 and Oceania to none, though the region floor of 4 still holds.
watching: Gulf energy attacks: a drone strike near Shaybah, an attack on Dammam airport, seven tankers Iran says were hit, and the US pulling families from Riyadh.
Brent futures diverging from physical crude as Gulf supply risk rises.
Iran mediation talks hosted in Istanbul.
Zelensky's backing of a frozen front line and the drone wave on Moscow.
Venezuela's blackouts and the protests in Maracaibo.
The eMudhra certificate-key compromise and its exit from TLS certificates.
coverageGaps: Africa carried 3 stories, down from 6, and Oceania none.

Several datelines are a country or region rather than a city (China, Mexico, United States, Myanmar, Netherlands, Switzerland, United Kingdom, Fertile Crescent), which the missing-dateline metric does not catch.
Two stories each on eMudhra and on Brent read as one developing event split in two; the same-event check did not flag either pair.
context: Science rose to 7 from 3, the best day this week, with Nature, New Scientist and Payload among the sources. Al Jazeera's share fell from 20% yesterday to 8%, and no outlet supplied more than 5 stories. Cycles averaged 1006s; selector 147s, writer 132s, editor 88s.
